forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Primary action — filled download buttons, outlined CTAs, and active nav indicators carry this deep botanical green that reads as decisive without aggression

vine.$description: Vine — Soft surface accent and gradient wash for feature sections — the mid-tone green that fades into the white canvas as ambient atmosphere

neon-sprout.$description: Neon Sprout — Decorative illustration fill and gradient endpoint — appears only inside brand graphics, never on UI controls

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Decorative illustration fill for brand mark and app icon glyphs — companion to Neon Sprout in the visual identity

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, heavy borders, and the dominant hairline divider color throughout the layout

graphite.$description: Graphite — Headline text and dark surface text — near-black with slight warmth for large display type

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary text, image overlays, and dark UI text on light backgrounds — the workhorse body tone

slate.$description: Slate — Body text helper copy and tertiary borders

fog.$description: Fog — Muted body text and subtle border tone for de-emphasized content

ash.$description: Ash — Icon strokes, placeholder text, and low-priority text color

mist.$description: Mist — Button borders and faint dividers — barely-there structural lines

cloud.$description: Cloud — Button background tint and elevated surface base

veil.$description: Veil — Hover states, tag backgrounds, and section background tint — the next surface above the canvas

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas and card surfaces — the dominant background that everything floats on

inter-variable.$description: Universal UI font — handles all navigation, body, button, card, and heading text from 12px captions to 36px section headers. Weight 500 carries medium-emphasis labels, weight 600 anchors the heaviest UI elements. Slightly tightened tracking at -0.02em to -0.03em keeps the geometric letterforms feeling engineered rather than soft.

poppins.$description: Display heading font — used exclusively for major section titles like 'Everything your AI agents and team need from meetings'. The weight 600 Poppins at 38px creates a distinct typographic register shift from the Inter body, making section titles feel like editorial headings rather than UI labels. Normal letter-spacing lets the geometric forms breathe.
